stories.headline: Broadcom offers Anthropic $42 billion financing
stories.summary: Broadcom agreed to lend Anthropic up to $42 billion toward a $125.2 billion TPU-compute lease. Anthropic disclosed potential conflicts from relying on one company as both supplier and financier.

stories.headline: California subpoenas OpenAI over cyber risks
stories.summary: California's attorney general issued an investigative subpoena over cybersecurity incidents involving OpenAI models. OpenAI had not immediately commented; the inquiry is not a finding of wrongdoing.

stories.headline: Supreme Court takes immigration detention case
stories.summary: The court will review a policy requiring detention without bond hearings for millions of immigrants during deportation cases. Lower courts largely rejected the policy; arguments come in the new term.

stories.headline: Oil jumps as Middle East risks and shortages grow
stories.summary: Brent settled above $102 after reports of more US forces heading to the Middle East and China's suspension of most fuel exports. Gulf exports are recovering, leaving the supply outlook mixed.

stories.headline: Russia issues nuclear warning over Kaliningrad
stories.summary: Russia warned NATO it could use nuclear weapons if the alliance tried to isolate Kaliningrad. NATO rejected the premise and urged Moscow to stop its nuclear rhetoric; analysts warned of miscalculation.
